## CI/CD Status

![CI Status](https://github.com/[USERNAME]/starmory-app/workflows/CI/badge.svg)

### What this workflow does:

1. ✅ Runs on every push to `dev` or `main` branches
2. ✅ Runs on every pull request
3. ✅ Installs Flutter dependencies
4. ✅ Runs all 85 unit tests
5. ✅ Generates coverage report
6. ✅ Uploads coverage to Codecov

### View Results:

After pushing, click on the "CI" checkmark next to your commit to see test results.

**Replace `[USERNAME]` with your actual GitHub username in the badge URL above.**
